description: The plot illustrates the average cosine similarity between generated training samples for each relation category, comparing different configurations of data processing. The x-axis represents the relation categories, ranging from 0 to 60, and the y-axis measures the mean interclass similarity, ranging from 0.06 to 0.5. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration: 'w/o DPO obo', 'w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint', 'DPO', 'Average of w/o DPO obo', and 'Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint'. The 'w/o DPO obo' line is blue with a solid line style, the 'w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint' line is orange with a dashed line style, the 'DPO' line is green with a dash-dot line style, the 'Average of w/o DPO obo' line is blue with a dotted line style, and the 'Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint' line is orange with a dash-dot line style. The plot shows variability in mean interclass similarity across different relation categories and configurations, with some peaks and declines observed.
